experiment.title: opamp_core PVT-corner open-loop AC / slew-rate / output-swing bench
experiment.claim: Op-amp-level (not bare-device) closed-loop/open-loop AC and transient measurements of design/netlist/opamp_core.spice against DR-002's schematic-level sizing estimates, over the confirmed 5-corner MOS grid at -40/27/125 C.
